creature_families: 54 Boss rows (Special=Boss) across the races; 20 rows with IDs 6000+ (12 flagged DoddlerCustomMonsters)

top_creatures.label: Clutch-spitting hoard beetle
top_creatures.why: A telegraphed egg volley every 200 ms; each egg lives about 5 s and has a 15 percent chance to become a summon; hides and heals below 40 percent HP
top_creatures.keep: Volley rhythm; eggs as separate small targets; hide phase below 40 percent HP
top_creatures.change: Our creature is a sand-crab that buries and sprays clutches; a three-beat volley; our own sound cue

top_creatures.label: Winged sentinel quartet
top_creatures.why: Four bosses in one race, all on the standard boss AI, with close attack timings (480 or 420) and different element tiers (Neutral4, Dark3, Holy3, Holy3): one family, four identities
top_creatures.keep: One family with shared timing; four element variants
top_creatures.change: Our names and our element set; only one sentinel attacks at a time

top_creatures.label: Ant brood trio with larvae
top_creatures.why: Three small fast soldiers plus larvae that assist; a many-vs-one read around one boss
top_creatures.keep: Small assist units; the egg as a stationary plant-AI object
top_creatures.change: Our insect family; larvae drag toward the player instead of looting

top_creatures.label: Spore-burst fungus field
top_creatures.why: A dense field of 90 spores with a 5-15 s respawn window; density reads as a hazard field
top_creatures.keep: Dense field with a short respawn; poison tiers 2 and 4
top_creatures.change: A spore bursts into a fan on death; no damage over time; our own ground tint

top_creatures.label: Silver-weak beast
top_creatures.why: Weakness written as a data tag, so any item rule can read it and the player has a reason to swap gear
top_creatures.change: Our weakness element (for example ice); a visible tell on the creature

top_creatures.label: Swarm summoner
top_creatures.why: One large demon calls ten small flyers at once; ten at once reads as a cloud at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: Big summoner with a fixed minion count
top_creatures.change: Our own flyers as a swarm of small winged shapes; our own call animation

top_creatures.label: Rare large dragon
top_creatures.why: The dragon race has only five rows, so the silhouette stays special; Large size class
top_creatures.keep: Rare race kept as reserved content; Large size class

top_creatures.label: Top-tier ghost boss
top_creatures.why: The only monster with the Ghost4 element tier; a unique tier gives it an identity; five minions
top_creatures.keep: A single top-tier element as identity; five minions
top_creatures.change: Our own ghost visual; a fade in and out instead of a fixed look
top_creatures.ref: Db/Monsters.csv line 51 (ID 4048, code GHOSTRING); Db/SpawnMinionTable.csv line 22

classes: Six first-tier classes (cap 50), Jobs.csv Id 1-6: sword melee with taunt and endure; archer with eye-buffs and volley; mage with elemental bolts and walls; acolyte with support; thief with stealth and ranged; merchant with a cart

Thirteen second-tier classes (cap 70), Jobs.csv Id 7-19; Skills/SkillTree.toml names six of them (knight, wizard, priest, hunter, assassin, blacksmith); seven not found in SkillTree.toml and not searched further
Three branch classes at cap 70 (Jobs.csv Id 20-22) and three at cap 50 (Id 23-25)
Progression: skill tree with prerequisites by rank (Skills/SkillTree.toml line 16); about 220 skill sections in Skills/Skills.toml; 78 status-effect sections in Skills/StatusEffects.toml
weapon_families: 22 weapon types (Db/ItemsWeapons.csv Type column): dagger 69 rows, sword 51, rod 35, mace 34, 2H sword 33, bow 31, 2H spear 30, whip 26, katar 25, knuckle 25, book 24, 2H axe 23, plus gun types (handgun, rifle, shotgun, gatling, grenade), shuriken and instrument
Tier by Rank column: rank 1 has 53 rows, rank 2 has 72, rank 3 has 198, rank 4 has 180; level ranges overlap across tiers, so tier is a power band, not a level gate
Elemental: 91 of 503 weapons carry a non-neutral property (wind 22, dark 15, fire 13, holy 13, water 11, earth 9, poison 3, undead 3, ghost 2)
Element swap: consumable items change weapon element (Script/Items/MiscEffects.txt lines 2-3)
Speed per class and weapon kind: Db/WeaponAttackTiming.csv; most cells 1 to 1.6, many cells read 4 (meaning not verified)
Refine success table: Db/RefineSuccess.csv (20 steps, four weapon tiers plus armour); rows 1-11 read; success falls from 100 to 10-20 percent by steps 10-11
gear_tiers: Armour rows: Db/Armor.csv 581 (headgear 198, body 43, accessory 27, footgear 12, shield 10, garment 8, 283 with no type); Db/ItemsEquipment.csv 555 rows
Tier shown by weapon Rank column, refine step, and a per-item sprite field (WeaponSprite on weapons); no metallic, gold or crystal shader found by file name in RebuildClient/Assets/Shaders
Material words in item names (not looks): ice 20, glass 10, gold 9, golden 5, silver 3, mithril 1, crystal 1, diamond 1; no mythic metal tier found in the tables read
Cards: 441 rows (Db/ItemsCards.csv); 440 card-effect lines (Script/Items/CardEffects.txt); card prefixes Low Level, Lucky, Aqua, Mirror
Card-pair sets: 22 sets (Script/Items/ComboEffects.txt); mini-boss pairs add flee 18 plus one small stat; other pairs differ (line 2: agility 5, flee 10)
Equipment effect example: one shield gives nine element resistances at 20 each (Script/Items/EquipmentEffects.txt line 4)
zones: Biomes by MapMode (Db/Maps.csv): field 142, dungeon 77, indoor 31, town 12, none 14; 276 map rows

Dungeon archetypes (18 warp files, Script/Warps/Dungeons): sewer, maze, tower, undersea tunnel, pyramid, sunken hull, magma vault, bug nest, orc camp, toy factory, clock tower, forest labyrinth, undead crypt, and others

Hazards: AllWater flag on undersea floors (Db/Maps.csv lines 32-33); NoTeleport flags on three maps; timed map-wide curse event (Script/Event/MiasmaDungeons.txt lines 12-13, 42-81); spore field (Script/Spawns/gef_dun.txt line 7)
Instances: 29 rows (Db/Instances.csv): job zones (line 25), guild realm, a war-of-siege comment row, dungeon and field instances

Top zone ideas: undersea tunnel floors (Maps.csv lines 32-33); timed curse pyramid with three waves (MiasmaDungeons.txt lines 42-81); spore field (gef_dun.txt line 7); job zones (Instances.csv line 25); guild realm (Instances.csv)

looks.label: Explosion frame strip with timing in the name
looks.technique: 17 frames at 0.1 s each; the delay is in the file name; an animator controller sits beside the strip

looks.label: Casting ring and motes
looks.technique: Additive particles with a soft fade by depth; a ring material and a firefly material

looks.label: Screen swirl for a status
looks.technique: Full-screen polar swirl with a sine wobble and a strength value from 0 to 1

looks.label: Crit digit style
looks.technique: Per-digit layout with a crit variant that adds horizontal jitter and a brightness factor

looks.label: Flying text path per damage type
looks.technique: Nine path assets (bounce, combo, critical, damage, debuff, effect, exp, heal, miss) each carry a trajectory curve and a size curve

looks.label: Window frame kit
looks.technique: Transparent and no-bottom variants of one frame, with corner and bottom handles
